title: Channel ledger (.github/channels/<channel>.json)
description: Reviewed state of one update channel. The unsigned manifest body is a pure function of this file, the release records and the trust chain; channel_ledger.py is the validator.

reason.description: A version moves back only with a reason starting 'yank <bad version>'.

history.description: Every version ever served per install_source; append only.

withdrawn_versions.description: Yanked versions; append only; carried into the manifest body.
